title: Multimeter Practice
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Set a virtual multimeter's mode, choose whether the circuit power is on, and connect the probes across two points or in series, then read the display. Six tasks from this book's circuits check that you can make all three choices correctly. Used in Chapter 7.

educational.topic: Using a multimeter: mode, power state and connection
learningObjectives: Use a virtual multimeter by choosing the correct mode, power state and connection for six measuring tasks from this book's circuits, with at least 5 of 6 tasks fully correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Carry out the whole measuring procedure by setting mode, power and connection, then see the reading that those settings produce
keyQuestions: Is this measurement a difference between two points or a flow through a wire?
Does this mode need the power on or off, and why?
commonMisconceptions: Current is measured across two points, like voltage
Resistance can be measured in a live circuit
Continuity is the same as voltage
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed settings of three choices each, one attempt each, no partial credit; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Circuit
values: One wire of a servo cable

controls.label: Check / Next task / See score / Try again
